title: Raghav Juyal's 'Bhai Tera Star Hai' Takes Aim at Bollywood With Meta Humor and a Nod to Salman Khan
excerpt: The dancer-turned-actor's upcoming comedy casts him as a delusional aspiring actor whose quest for stardom includes a tongue-in-cheek audition for a Salman Khan film. It releases July 30.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Raghav Juyal stars in comedy 'Bhai Tera Star Hai', releasing July 30.
  • The film includes a meta reference to Juyal's role in 'Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan'.
  • Directed by Vivek B. Agrawal, the film features a diverse ensemble cast.
  • Juyal credits Shah Rukh Khan as a mentor influencing his performance.
Raghav Juyal's Comedy Journey
›Juyal's first lead in a comedy film.
›Transitioned from dancer to actor.
›Previous roles in action films like 'Kill'.
›Film satirizes Bollywood's obsession with stardom.
Entertainment article
  • Raghav Juyal stars as Ajay Singh, a delusional struggling actor, in the upcoming comedy Bhai Tera Star Hai, releasing July 30
  • The trailer includes a meta reference to Salman Khan's Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan, in which Juyal actually appeared
  • Directed by Vivek B. Agrawal, the film features Sanjay Kapoor, Chandan Roy Sanyal, Barkha Singh, and Parvathy Omanakuttan
  • Juyal has credited Shah Rukh Khan as a mentor who influenced his approach to the role

Raghav Juyal is trading the intense action of Kill and The Ba***ds of Bollywood for outright comedy in Bhai Tera Star Hai, a film that doubles as both a satire of Bollywood stardom and a showcase for the dancer-turned-actor's comic timing.

> **"Agrawal and produced by Eastwood Pictures, the film brings together a varied cast."** https://www.instagram.com/p/DbBYhoauByf/

The trailer, which has drawn a strong response online since its release, follows Ajay Singh — a struggling actor whose supreme confidence vastly outstrips his actual talent. Each attempt to fix a problem lands him in a bigger mess, setting up what the filmmakers promise is an out-and-out entertainer.

The Salman Khan Connection

The trailer's most talked-about moment is a self-referential nod to Juyal's own filmography. In a scene with Sanjay Kapoor, his character claims to have auditioned for a role as "Bhaijaan's brother" in a film called Kisi Ka Bhai, Kisi Ki Behen — a clear callback to Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan, the 2023 Salman Khan film in which Juyal actually appeared.

https://x.com/ATSBB/status/2079563441329914343

Juyal has spoken about the meta joke in recent interviews, revealing that Salman Khan personally called him after seeing the reference. The actor recalled his initial surprise at getting a call from Khan for the original film.

"I was in shock because never in my wildest dream did I ever think that Salman Khan would call me directly. I rushed to the phone thinking that he would ask me to choreograph but instead, I was surprised to know that he was offering me a role in his film."

— Raghav Juyal

Juyal has also credited Shah Rukh Khan as a mentor whose guidance influenced his performance in the new film.

Ensemble Cast and Crew

Directed by Vivek B. Directed by Vivek B. Agrawal and produced by Eastwood Pictures, the film brings together a varied cast. Sanjay Kapoor, Chandan Roy Sanyal, Barkha Singh, Vivan Bhatena, Tina Desai, and former Miss World first runner-up Parvathy Omanakuttan all feature alongside Juyal.

"Agrawal and produced by Eastwood Pictures, the film brings together a varied cast."

The trailer leans heavily on rapid-fire dialogue and absurdist setups. One sequence involves Ajay concocting an elaborate scheme involving fake pregnancy claims to raise money, a gag that typifies the film's irreverent tone.

From Dancer to Leading Man

Juyal's trajectory from reality TV dance star to Bollywood leading man has been one of the more unusual career arcs in recent Hindi cinema. After years as a host and dancer on competition shows, he broke through as an actor with action roles in Kill and has since expanded his range.

Bhai Tera Star Hai represents his first out-and-out comedy lead, and the trailer suggests a film that embraces Bollywood's excesses while simultaneously poking fun at them. The self-aware humor — an aspiring actor who believes his own hype — offers a comedic counterpoint to the industry's well-documented obsession with stardom.

The film releases in cinemas on July 30, 2023.
